doctrines.name: Sword Creed
doctrines.motto: One clean edge answers more than a hundred arguments.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of duelists. Few members, but every one of them a blade.

doctrines.name: Alchemy Creed
doctrines.motto: What the body lacks, the furnace can supply.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of refiners. Fewer swords, but the treasury fills faster.

doctrines.name: Formation Creed
doctrines.motto: A wall is only the outermost line of a formation.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of wardens. The widest roster and a modest levy.

options.name: Light tithe
options.blurb: The levy is halved; the hall lives lean and liked.

options.name: Standard tithe
options.blurb: The levy as every hall expects it.

options.name: Heavy tithe
options.blurb: The levy rises by three fifths; full coffers, thin patience.

options.name: Open gates
options.blurb: Petitioners come and go; the world knocks.

options.name: Secluded gates
options.blurb: No petitioners; the quiet doubles the chance of found wealth.

options.name: Guard rota
options.blurb: Raids bite two fifths less; the rota costs a stone a day.

options.name: Open recruitment
options.blurb: Any friend of the hall may be asked.

options.name: Selective recruitment
options.blurb: Only the sworn-close may be asked; a smaller, tighter hall.

buildings.name: Training Yard
buildings.blurb: Capacity +2. Disputes halve — drilled disciples argue less.

buildings.name: Pill Garden
buildings.blurb: The beds yield two stones of levy a day.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.blurb: A stone a day from the work, and raids bite a fifth less again.

buildings.name: Deep Vault
buildings.blurb: Losses from ill fortune are halved before they land.
